immich-go — Immich server reimplemented in Go. Single binary, embedded
SQLite, built-in web UI. No Node.js / external services.
  ./immich-go            # http://0.0.0.0:8081  (admin@immich.app / password)
Env: IMMICH_PORT, IMMICH_DB, IMMICH_RESOURCE, IMMICH_JWT_SECRET,
IMMICH_API_KEY_SALT. See USER_MANUAL.md.
